# Future Brain Marketing

> Performance marketing practice based in Greece, working with clients worldwide. Manages Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, with an AI-assisted workflow under human supervision. Specialism in travel and hospitality. No contracts and no minimum budget. A free written account audit is offered.

## Services

- [Google Ads management](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/google-ads.html): Google Ads management for Search, Shopping, Performance Max and app campaigns, built to turn ad spend into revenue. No contracts, no minimum budget. Free audit.
- [Microsoft Ads management](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/microsoft-ads.html): Microsoft Ads management for Bing search and shopping campaigns. Reach the searchers Google misses. No contracts, no minimum budget. Free account audit.
- [Apple Search Ads management](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/apple-search-ads.html): Apple Search Ads management for app install campaigns on the App Store: keyword structure, bids and custom product pages. No contracts. Free account audit.
- [Meta Ads management](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/meta-ads.html): Meta Ads management for Facebook and Instagram: prospecting, retargeting and creative testing that support your search campaigns. No contracts. Free audit.
- [Travel PPC management](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/travel.html): Paid acquisition for ferry operators, booking platforms, tour operators, hotels and rentals.

## Results

Paid acquisition for a global ferry booking platform, November 2025 to October 2026:

- 7.0 million euros of ad spend managed across four platforms
- 68 million euros of booking value, a 9.7x return on ad spend
- Campaigns in 24 languages
- Google Ads: booking value from core market campaigns up 112% year on year
- Microsoft Ads: 11.4x return on ad spend
- Apple Search Ads: app installs up 60%, cost per install down 30%
- Meta Ads: cost per conversion down 22%

## Case studies

- [Travel PPC case study](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/case-study-travel-ppc.html): Travel PPC case study: €7M of ad spend and €68M of bookings for a global ferry booking platform across Google, Microsoft, Apple and Meta Ads in 24 languages.
- [E-commerce Google Ads case study](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/case-study-ecommerce-google-ads.html): E-commerce Google Ads case study: campaigns built from scratch for an online car audio retailer. 15,100 conversions at $2.85 each from $43K of ad spend.
- [B2B Google Ads case study](https://futurebrainmarketing.com/case-study-b2b-google-ads.html): B2B Google Ads case study: campaigns for an industrial kiln manufacturer. 1,920 conversions at $35.16 each from $67.4K of ad spend.
